subject: rc
title: RC.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 162 (SR(TRS)II-18). RC (race) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: RE-ST (restructuralism) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From RE-ST: STY (style) and INFO-DY (information dynamics). From SPT-DY: ATTN (attraction). From STY: IST-PT (isolated particulars). From INFO-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From IST-PT: INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality). From AF-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics).
